shortDefinition.en: The diagonal of a 36 × 24 mm reference frame divided by the diagonal of the format being compared, used to compare field of view rather than to alter a lens's focal length.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 以 36 × 24 mm 参考画幅的对角线除以待比较画幅的对角线，用于比较视角，而不是改变镜头的实际焦距。

en: Crop factor does not physically multiply the focal length or f-number of a lens.
zh-cn: 裁切系数不会实际改变镜头的焦距或光圈 f 值。

example.en: A 50 mm lens on a camera with a crop factor of about 1.5 gives a field of view similar to a 75 mm lens on full frame, from the same position.
example.zh-cn: 在相同拍摄位置，50 mm 镜头用于裁切系数约为 1.5 的相机，其视角大致相当于全画幅上的 75 mm 镜头。

sources.title: The DX and FX Formats — Nikon
sources.locator: Can you use an FX lens on a DX camera body?
sources.supports: The DX/FX comparison, 1.5× crop factor, and the example that a 24 mm lens on DX gives an approximate 36 mm view.
